rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday word for eating utensils, including knives, forks and spoons.

example.english: Remember to set out the silverware before eating.
example.jyutping: sik6 faan6 cin4 gei3 dak1 baai2 hou2 caan1 geoi6

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the knives, forks and spoons rather than tableware in general.

example.english: There isn't any silverware on the table, so how are we supposed to eat steak?
example.traditional: 張枱上面冇刀叉匙羹，點食牛扒呀？
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 soeng6 min6 mou5 dou1 caa1 ci4 gang1 dim2 sik6 ngau4 paa2 aa3
